events.event: Initial Changesets setup created `package.json` and `package-lock.json` at version `0.0.0`.

TDD was first reshaped into a compact reference-only workflow with pre-agreed seams, then five minutes later the refactor stage was explicitly removed so TDD became red → green and refactoring moved to review.
events.current_significance: Establishes exact lineage for current red → green semantics and confirms red-green-refactor wording on secondary surfaces is stale rather than ambiguous.

events.event: PR #536 / commit `42a5b70fcacc7baff1977b13f3919fb2f63af14e` created the native Claude Code plugin with an explicit curated 21-skill manifest at v1.2.0. That PR itself documented one pre-existing promoted-bucket gap: `resolving-merge-conflicts` was in Engineering with docs but absent from both `plugin.json` and top-level README. PR #539 / commit `d3275456a453ae93260abb9c945af60c259cdc6d` fixed that invariant and audited the rest of the promoted set. Subsequent promoted-set mutations are individually traceable: PR #593 / commit `0f2bdbdb06220d2df3718b8f0483157c6c8a8600` graduated `to-questionnaire`; PR #680 / commit `b3376f8d39848dd08572ec2667da4739a67c8c04` graduated `wizard`; PR #751 / commit `355fa7420b418af838998f7ec4365ceda1c8dfcc` added `wait-what`; PR #650 / merge `fa3b2a6b355cf77ee0f2fb8c347f62ec42bbf022` renamed `writing-great-skills` to `writing-for-agents` with no alias and updated `plugin.json`.
events.current_significance: Reconciles the full curated Claude-plugin membership evolution to the frozen 25-skill set. The promoted plugin set is an explicit maintained subset, not a recursive bucket discovery rule.

events.area: Codex metadata owner-set and invocation lineage
events.event: PR #551 / commit `697d4ce9742da558fd1ba6697c8e9775e2e302dd` introduced `agents/openai.yaml` beside every then-current `SKILL.md`: exactly 39 owner files, with 22 user-invoked skills carrying `policy.allow_implicit_invocation: false`, plus the shared `AGENTS.md` symlink/invocation documentation. The owner-set evolution to the frozen 37 is exactly accountible: PR #572 / merge `e9fcdf95b402d360f90f1db8d776d5dd450f9234` added `to-questionnaire` with its sidecar (+1); PR #751 / merge `c64fa7ecf658dc2a507a9192c7c6da61dc4d5960` added `wait-what` with its sidecar (+1); PR #752 / commit `c66bdeeee002d81e3f8b21403c07f9a0d7bea6da` removed four deprecated skills and two personal skills, each present in the original 39 (-6); PR #926 / merge `163b780f98079010cfaff187cfcb9cb24f31998f` added `implement-spec` with its sidecar (+1); commits `8fa188659c5f102894807854bed9d2eee4a711f4` and `3ec8e2399438cd5603324df8263acf3b64cf69b8` introduced and then refined `retro` with its OpenAI sidecar (+1). The `writing-great-skills` → `writing-for-agents` move in PR #650 is count-neutral. Therefore 39 + 1 + 1 - 6 + 1 + 1 = 37, matching the frozen foundation validator’s 37 current skills / 37 Codex metadata owners. Invocation-mode corrections are also traced: PR #762 / head `61accb0e66652cfe71da1266d49f1cbd129e3ae1` deliberately made `wizard` model-invoked by removing both Claude’s `disable-model-invocation` and Codex’s `allow_implicit_invocation: false`; PR #650 intended `writing-for-agents` to become model-invoked but moved a stale sidecar, and PR #766 / commit `4aaccb58d40559d7e3c59a029b2290ae5ba538de` fixed that Codex regression by removing the stale policy block and stale display metadata.
events.current_significance: Reconciles both the complete owner-count evolution and the two material post-introduction invocation-policy corrections to the frozen 37/37 dual-harness state. It also provides a concrete historical example of why metadata presence alone is insufficient: semantic invocation parity can drift even when every skill has a sidecar.

Added `sync-plugin-version.mjs`; package.json made effective authority for plugin version; release action switched to `npm run version`.

events.event: PR #878 standardized operative cross-skill calls on explicit Skill-tool phrasing.
events.current_significance: Solved unreliable bare `/skill` prose but introduced semantic regression.

events.event: PR #880 fixed calls to user-invoked targets and added target-invocation-type carve-out to policy.
events.current_significance: Canonical example of syntax-correct rewrite violating higher-level invariant.

events.event: PR #1025 changed local linking from every non-deprecated current skill to engineering + productivity + in-progress only by adding an explicit `misc/` exclusion. The PR states that all four misc skills had previously been symlinked into both local harness directories, that `misc/README.md` already described them as rarely used/not promoted, and that `in-progress/` remained linked deliberately because it is public and feedback-seeking. The same PR updated `CLAUDE.md` so the governance prose no longer claimed the script links “every skill.”
events.current_significance: Reconciles both the pre-frozen behavior and the rationale for the frozen 33-skill local-link set. The difference from the 25-skill plugin set is intentional: `in-progress/` is local-feedback surface, while `misc/` is excluded from both daily-driver local install and promoted plugin distribution.

events.event: `skills/misc/scaffold-exercises/SKILL.md` was introduced already containing both the broad “at least one of problem/solution/explainer” rule and the narrower linter summary requiring problem/explainer/explainer.1. The file has one path-history commit, and its creation blob SHA `d87df28e7d8abb4e57ecc6e47d71c274d16054c7` is identical to the frozen-baseline blob SHA.
events.current_significance: CT-020 is an introduction-time internal contract mismatch that remained byte-for-byte unchanged through the frozen baseline, not a later regression.
